results.nl: A bond issued by a government is inferred to be a Government Bond (issuer-based sufficient condition).
A bond issued by a corporation is inferred to be a Corporate Bond.
A derivative whose underlying is an equity is inferred to be an Equity Derivative.
A derivative whose underlying is a commodity is inferred to be a Commodity Derivative.
A derivative whose underlying is a currency is inferred to be a Currency Derivative.
A derivative on an equity underlying is inferred to be a Security via the chain EquityDerivative < Derivative < Security.
A bond issued by a municipality is inferred to be a Debt Instrument via MunicipalBond < Bond < DebtInstrument.
A Call Option is a Security (CallOption < Option < Derivative < Security).
A Treasury Bill is a Security (TreasuryBill < MoneyMarketInstrument < DebtInstrument < Security).
A Mortgage-Backed Security is a Security (MortgageBackedSecurity < AssetBackedSecurity < DebtInstrument < Security).
A Common Stock is an Asset (CommonStock < Equity < Security < Asset).
An instrument cannot be both a Common Stock and a Preferred Stock (equity kinds are disjoint).
A contract cannot be both an Option and a Future (derivative kinds are disjoint).
An instrument cannot be both a Bond and a Money Market Instrument (debt kinds are disjoint).
A fund cannot be both a Mutual Fund and a Hedge Fund (fund kinds are disjoint).
A bond cannot have two different issuers (exactly-one-issuer constraint on debt instruments).
A convertible bond is a legitimate instrument: an individual ConvertibleBond does not make the ontology inconsistent (bond-with-equity-feature must not be modelled as a disjointness clash).
A preferred stock is a legitimate instrument: an individual PreferredStock (equity with debt-like features) must be satisfiable.
A zero-coupon bond is a legitimate instrument: an individual ZeroCouponBond (bond without coupon payments) must be satisfiable.
A future on a commodity underlying is a legitimate combination: Future + hasUnderlying Commodity must be satisfiable.
A fund that tracks a market index is inferred to be an Index Fund.
